description: Boot step-02 (Task G 72-hour look-ahead) reported 14 additional events for Aug 22-24; actual count in data/calendar-unified.json was 13 (1 on Aug 22, 0 on Aug 23, 12 on Aug 24). Separately, Task H (email triage) reported 22 messages scanned but data/email-unified.json only contained 11 message objects in its array, an internal count/content mismatch. Both caught by Ralph during the mandatory step-03 verification gate, not self-caught before Ralph ran.
correction: Recounted calendar-unified.json programmatically (13 events for the 3-day look-ahead window) and rebuilt email-unified.json with all 22 message objects from the original M365 search response instead of a truncated/summarized subset.
systemic_fix: When writing summary counts into a data file, count the array being written (or generate the count programmatically) rather than restating a total from an earlier tool call after the array has been trimmed or summarized for brevity.
